out_of_scope.reason: Spec §1.2: 'Curses and magical contagions' and 'sentient or cursed items' are out of scope. None of the 32 subset spells, 14 monsters or 7 magic items confers a curse.
No in-scope effect confers a curse, so there is nothing whose definition could decide what a curse does.

Remove Curse (level 3) and Greater Restoration (level 5) are above the level-2 spell subset. No in-scope magic explicitly ends curses, and with no curses implemented, a negative test (Lesser Restoration doesn't end a curse) can't be set up.

A.summary: This is a definitional entry. Effects can curse a creature or an object, and the effect that confers the curse defines what it does.
